items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Not people like Steiner, or people like that. [INTERVIEWEE] John was interested in it, but I don't think he did anything there.

ctx.x: I started them and then some other people took them over because I had to go away and I think --
Not people like Steiner, or people like that.

John was interested in it, but I don't think he did anything there. Yes, he did have that record label he was quite a guy by the way. It was a great little club though. But you know, after all, I couldn't run a club, what experience did I have.
